set.body: Goal: make atlas provenance audit-grade without losing Scala 3 clarity. Add a typed provenance layer behind AtlasRef: typed atlas identity/release, spatial support, artifact roles, source artifacts, label schema, derivation steps, citations, confidence, and validation. Scope: keep AtlasRef as a compact compatibility header; add AtlasProvenance and ADTs in shared atlas code; wire VolumeAtlas and SurfaceAtlas to expose provenance; update Schaefer/Glasser/Brainnetome/ASEG loaders and surface descriptors to build structured provenance; record label filtering/remapping decisions; test that standard atlases carry source artifacts, spatial support, label schema, citations where known, and derivation history. Non-goals: executing TemplateFlow/Workbench transforms, adding new atlas downloads, or surface annotation/CIFTI parsing.
set.title: Epic: Typed atlas provenance hardening
